boundary.message: The water is too cold out there. You turn back to the jetty.

content.outro: Behind you the bell has stopped swinging. Out on the stack, the thing stands where it rose, and it is still there.
content.premise: A stone jetty at the mouth of a grey bay, a harbour hall at its foot, and a sea-stack ninety blocks out that the keeper will not look at. Ring the bell at the end of the jetty and see what stands up on it.
content.theme: A bay at dusk, a keeper who knows what the bell is for, and something on a rock across the water.
content.title: The Thing Across the Water
